location: WEH - Kalanagar Junction / Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC) Connector
primaryContributingFactor: Heavy 6-lane into 3-lane vehicular necking at Dharavi slip merge combined with BKC flyover exit queueing.
recurringPropagation: Spills backward 4.2 km up to Santacruz Airport flyover.

recommendedInterventions.description: Adaptive dynamic green extension of 25 seconds for Western Express mainline during 08:45 - 10:15.
Deploy cone-barrier reversible tidal 4th lane southbound from 08:30 - 11:00.

location: Wardha Road - Rahate Colony Square to Sitabuldi
primaryContributingFactor: Unregulated bus stop positioning right before left-turn slip road causing complete blockage of turning lane.
recurringPropagation: Spills onto Ajni railway overbridge approach.

recommendedInterventions.description: Shift MSRTC / City bus stop 75 meters south into designated recessed passenger bay.

location: Hinjawadi IT Corridor - Shivaji Chowk Phase 1
primaryContributingFactor: Single ingress artery receiving combined traffic from Wakad, Bhumkar, and Punawale bridges with zero dedicated turning bays.
recurringPropagation: Tailbacks reach 5.5 km back across Wakad Bridge onto NH48 bypass.

recommendedInterventions.description: Implement clockwise circular one-way loop via Marunji Road for outbound evening traffic.
